Infant (0–6 mo): Breastfeed on demand. Encourage tummy time. Track wet diapers.
Toddler (1–3 yrs): Introduce solid foods. Encourage walking. Start simple routines.
Sleep Tips: Keep a calm bedtime. Avoid screens 1hr before sleep. Use nightlights.
Developmental Milestones: Look for crawling, babbling, and responding to names.
